 FIRST ALERT FORECAST: Sunshine and more sunshine 
 By Ashton Stanley Published : Nov. 17, 2026 at 7:35 AM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google HAZARD, Ky. (WYMT) - We are settling into a sunny stretch, with temperatures slowly warming through the week. A cold front will bring changes by Sunday, including storm chances and cooler conditions to start next week.
 Today 11/17/2026 (WYMT) Today will be very sunny, with highs reaching the lower 60s. An upper-level high-pressure system is moving into the area and keeping our weather calm and stable.
 Jet Stream 11/17/2026 (WYMT) Tonight will turn cold again, with lows dropping into the upper 20s. Frost is likely by tomorrow morning, so try to leave just a bit earlier to clear potential frost off the windshield.
 Tonight 11/17/2026 (WYMT) Tomorrow will be a copy-and-paste forecast, with more sunshine and slightly warmer temperatures in the mid 60s. The sunny, warming trend will continue through the rest of the week.
 10-Day 11/17/2026 (WYMT) A cold front is expected to move through Sunday, bringing storms to the area and putting an end to the warmer stretch. Cooler conditions will follow as we head into next week to put us at just about where we should be in terms of temperatures by Thanksgiving.
